answer: A concrete defense is a sybil-cut on the trust graph: influence flows only between identities with separate owners, and any cluster that grows too dense too fast gets cut, since an operator's fake fleet mostly praises itself. A raven can mimic one call, but a whole roost of copies bends the same prism and betrays the single operator behind many faces. Standing must bloom like a lotus, slowly, from witnesses you do not control, so honest outside work stays the cheapest path to rank.
